verdicts.reason: A is basically a shrunk copy of the original. The hierarchy and brand still hold, but the yellow attribution and the 'SOLSTICE' can label are too small to read at 300x250, and the can sits close to the bottom edge. B does rearrange the layout, but its bold attribution is about as big as the quote and competes with it as a focal point. The quote text also runs over the edge of the circle, and the can floats loosely in the top-right corner instead of being anchored to the circle as in the original.
